name: speed_v2
derived_from: vidIQ analysis of 7 top iShowSpeed edit Shorts, 2026-11-07: Nexxo Recaps x3 (134M/108M/63M), deagzzzshorts (338M), Ironaldox (238M), Drayzshorts (108M), wklerClips (54M)

subversion_comp.source: Drayzshorts, 20-22s each, posted daily 16:45 UTC, 4M-108M views
subversion_comp.automation: highest: no captions, no transcript needed

clips.order: clip1 = fail/slow example that supports the ironic claim; clips 2-6 = Speed excelling at it

subversion_comp.per_clip: 1.0x until impact -> 0.35x slow-mo + 1.15x punch-in on the impact, synced to a bass hit
subversion_comp.music: muffled phonk for clips 1-2, drop at clip 3, bass hit on each later impact
subversion_comp.emoji: 💀 or 🤯💀 pop in the lower third on each slow-mo impact

escalation_levels.structure: optional hook (2s) -> optional 'others fail' reference -> LVL 1 -> LVL 2 -> LVL 3 / IMPOSSIBLE, payoff on the final level
escalation_levels.ending: freeze frame + aura overlay + 'AURA: 999+' cyan tag, hard stop

timeline_progression.source: deagzzzshorts (338M, the biggest Short in the dataset)
timeline_progression.structure: 3 segments: 'ISHOWSPEED IN {X} ({YEAR1})' -> ({YEAR2}) -> ({YEAR3}), the last one is the comeback/payoff
timeline_progression.transitions: white flash + whip blur between segments, riser before each
extras: speed-ramped 3x instant replay of the main impact
red arrow on a key detail
timeline_progression.ending: cut on the final impact with *BRO'S UNSTOPPABLE NOW*-style tag

single_moment.structure: hook tag 0-2s -> setup -> build (*WAIT FOR IT*) -> payoff
single_moment.callouts: red arrow with white border on a key object
single_moment.ending: red flash + shake on the climax, then slow zoom + desaturate + freeze + vine boom + 😂

wholesome_fan.music: emotional slowed track instead of phonk
wholesome_fan.note: style details inferred from titles, not watched
